pages.text: The first expedition walked until the snow stopped melting. The citadel stands on snowy plains - above ground a ruin and a gate with a tower, the rest deep beneath.
Whoever seeks it should begin at the expedition's camp and the watchtower. Their lecterns tell the beginning of this story.

"The Lamplighter still keeps the lantern. Under it he holds a chained chest, the key on him, and in the chest the wedge we forged for the Crown, and the key to the descent."$(br2)"Without the warmth from the camp you will not last an hour under the Crown."
